Cost depends on factors like task complexity, how much context and data are involved, which tools and connections are active, automation frequency, and the intelligence level you choose. Paid plans include a monthly credit allocation. In addition, all users receive daily bonus credits when they visit the app: 300 credits per day on the Free plan and 600 credits per day on paid plans. Daily bonus credits reset at Midnight UTC. Monthly credits reset each billing cycle and do not roll over. To optimize credit usage, reduce unnecessary AI invocations, tune intelligence levels for the task, remove unnecessary tools, and start fresh chats for unrelated work. What are the different intelligence levels?Intelligence levels determine how capable your agents are at handling complex tasks. Higher levels use more advanced AI models but consume more credits. Basic is fast and cost-effective, while Advanced, Expert, and Genius progressively increase capability for more demanding work. How many services can I connect to? How many agents can I create?All plans allow you to connect an unlimited number of services using our thousands of built-in integrations, direct API access, and MCP support. You can also create an unlimited number of agents. Can my agents use a browser or run code?Yes. Every agent can directly search and read websites. Paid plans also include a dedicated web browser for navigating complex sites, logging in, and filling out forms. Every agent also has a sandboxed command-line environment where it can run scripts, process files, and use developer tools. What support is included?All paid plans include email support. Plans of $250 per month or more also include live video support with our team for more hands-on help. What are one-time credit purchases?One-time credits let paid-plan customers top up their account without changing their subscription. They can be purchased in amounts from $25 to $10,000. One-time credits are valid for one year from purchase, require an active subscription, and are used only after all other credits are consumed. Can I choose a custom monthly plan amount?Yes. Once you have a paid monthly plan, you can choose any amount from $25 to $10,000 in $5 increments through Stripe. Go to Settings → Org → Billing and select Manage billing. In Stripe, open your subscription and update its quantity. Each quantity unit is $5 per month and includes 2,000 monthly credits—for example, a quantity of 110 gives you a $550 monthly plan with 220,000 credits. Can I cancel or change my plan at any time?Yes. Upgrades take effect immediately without changing your billing cycle date and issue a prorated credit grant for the remainder of the current period. Downgrades and cancellations take effect at the end of your current billing period. Can I try Tasklet for free?Yes. The Free plan lets you explore Tasklet without any commitment. You can upgrade whenever you are ready. Do you offer refunds?If you are unhappy with Tasklet, we will provide a refund upon request within 14 days of your payment for amounts up to $250. Beyond that, refunds are not available. Please downgrade your account to the Free plan before contacting our team. For more information or custom enterprise pricing, please contact our team . We’re a small, ambitious team in San Francisco building agents that do real work for companies. All positions are full-time and in person · San Francisco, CA Open roles 6 positions Head of Design Engineering Own and implement the product experience for how people and teams work with AI agents. View role → Software Engineer — Platform Build the product foundations, integrations, and business systems that let Tasklet work across a company’s tools. View role → Software Engineer — AI Infra Build the agent runtime, execution environment, and infrastructure that make Tasklet’s agents capable and reliable. View role → Software Engineer — Product Design and ship the product experiences that make powerful agents feel simple, trustworthy, and delightful. View role → Customer Success Engineer Help customers succeed, solve their hardest problems, and use automation to make support continuously better. View role → Sales Executive Own the full sales cycle and show businesses how AI agents can transform the way they work. View role → Apply by sending a video Show us who you are. To apply, email our CEO Andrew (andrew@tasklet.ai ) with your resume, relevant links, and a video introduction no more than five minutes long. Your video must include the following: Who you are & why you want to join Tasklet A confirmation that you are able to work full-time, in-person in SF (including any required work authorizations - we are not sponsoring visas at this time) A demo of the most impressive thing you've made recently that’s relevant to the role you’re applying for. Make sure to show what you made, not just tell us. Email Andrew About Tasklet Building the AI work platform for business. Tasklet is building the AI platform companies use to run their business on agents. Our customers describe an outcome in plain English, and Tasklet gets the work done—across SaaS tools, APIs, browsers, files, spreadsheets, and internal systems. Agents can respond immediately or run business processes in the cloud 24×7 on a schedule or in response to events. Every Tasklet agent gets its own cloud computers, filesystem, database, and browser. Tasklet agents are built to do real work at real companies where many people are involved in each function. Teams share agents, knowledge, connections, and conversations, while administrators control access, behavior, and spend. Tasklet users can choose among models and delegate work to faster, cheaper ones—giving companies one flexible platform instead of a growing pile of disconnected AI seats. We compete with ChatGPT Work and Claude Cowork. OpenAI and Anthropic have their own models, massive funding, and existing distribution. We have a small, exceptional team, the freedom to use the best AI tech from any vendor, and a laser focus on the problems of real-world businesses where making agents simple, trustworthy, and easy to control matters just as much as making them intelligent. The labs will define what intelligence can do, but Tasklet will define how businesses put that intelligence to work. A small, AGI-pilled team that can win. Our team of 12 is based in San Francisco and is led by founders Andrew Lee (formerly founded Firebase & sold it to Google) and Jonny Dimond and includes Will Chambers , Hiranya Jayathilaka , Michael Lehenbauer , Michael Latman , Parker Chun , Christiana Stubblefield , Tyler Rockwood , Mark Robinson , Geoff Hamilton , and Austin Haag . We believe we have the right skills and are uniquely positioned to seize this unique moment. We have deep experience building agent systems, cloud infrastructure & productivity tools gained through our work building Shortwave , Firebase and critical infrastructure at Google, Amazon, OpenAI, Salesforce and elsewhere. We’re constantly looking for ways to give models more agency & leverage, and we reach for AI first when solving any problem. We’re especially excited about finding ways to close the loop on recursive self-improvement to get humans out of the way of building our business when possible. Nearly every line of code here is written with AI. Well-funded & backed by top-tier investors. We’ve raised over $42M from Union Square Ventures , Lightspeed Venture Partners , Y Combinator , Jeff Dean , Patrick & John Collison and others. Our most recent funding round was raised with a valuation cap of $500M. Culture A high-performance, results-focused culture. Tasklet is a fast-paced, engineering-driven, results-oriented company. We aim to build a truly world-class team & an amazing work environment. These are the values we aspire to: Understand our users & solve their A+ problemsYou focus on the problems that really matter — not the ones you already know how to solve. You take responsibility for delivering experiences that our users love — end-to-end. This requires a deep understanding of our users, their workflows, and how AI agents can transform them. Relentlessly pursue a vision for excellence, but ship todayIn the world of AI agents, things change rapidly, and you hustle to stay ahead. You iterate with extreme urgency, shipping improvements daily that compound into transformative capabilities over time. You aim high, know where you're going, and don't stop until it's amazing. LeadYou accomplish far more through teamwork than you could individually. You enable teamwork by being a leader, and you lead by doing, not just by talking. Take initiativeYou act like an owner and make great things happen without being asked. You try to be the change you want to see in the world. You believe nothing is someone else's problem. Be honest & truth seekingYou’re committed to finding & communicating the truth. You follow evidence, not your ego. You speak your mind and let others speak theirs. Deliver business resultsYou know that results — not effort — are what counts, and you take responsibility for our hardest & most important work: figuring out what needs to be done to get the right results. You own the results you produce, including your failures. $20,000 referral bonus Do you know someone who's a great fit for any of our roles? Refer them to us and we will pay you $20k if we hire them. Simply have them apply and mention in their application that you referred them. Some eligibility restrictions apply: You must be a US resident You must be the first person to refer someone to us (and we must not already be in contact with them) The candidate must start work within 3 months of your referral Payment will be made after their start date Eligibility decisions are made at our sole discretion Tasklet Run your business on agents Product Learn Use cases Desktop app Pricing Blog Changelog Company Contact Careers LinkedIn X Legal & Compliance Terms of service Privacy policy Trust Center

Cost depends on factors like task complexity, how much context and data are involved, which tools and connections are active, automation frequency, and the intelligence level you choose. Paid plans include a monthly credit allocation. In addition, all users receive daily bonus credits when they visit the app: 300 credits per day on the Free plan and 600 credits per day on paid plans. Daily bonus credits reset at Midnight UTC. Monthly credits reset each billing cycle and do not roll over. To optimize credit usage, reduce unnecessary AI invocations, tune intelligence levels for the task, remove unnecessary tools, and start fresh chats for unrelated work. What are the different intelligence levels?Intelligence levels determine how capable your agents are at handling complex tasks. Higher levels use more advanced AI models but consume more credits. Basic is fast and cost-effective, while Advanced, Expert, and Genius progressively increase capability for more demanding work. How many services can I connect to? How many agents can I create?All plans allow you to connect an unlimited number of services using our thousands of built-in integrations, direct API access, and MCP support. You can also create an unlimited number of agents. Can my agents use a browser or run code?Yes. Every agent can directly search and read websites. Paid plans also include a dedicated web browser for navigating complex sites, logging in, and filling out forms. Every agent also has a sandboxed command-line environment where it can run scripts, process files, and use developer tools. What support is included?All paid plans include email support. Plans of $250 per month or more also include live video support with our team for more hands-on help. What are one-time credit purchases?One-time credits let paid-plan customers top up their account without changing their subscription. They can be purchased in amounts from $25 to $10,000. One-time credits are valid for one year from purchase, require an active subscription, and are used only after all other credits are consumed. Can I choose a custom monthly plan amount?Yes. Once you have a paid monthly plan, you can choose any amount from $25 to $10,000 in $5 increments through Stripe. Go to Settings → Org → Billing and select Manage billing. In Stripe, open your subscription and update its quantity. Each quantity unit is $5 per month and includes 2,000 monthly credits—for example, a quantity of 110 gives you a $550 monthly plan with 220,000 credits. Can I cancel or change my plan at any time?Yes. Upgrades take effect immediately without changing your billing cycle date and issue a prorated credit grant for the remainder of the current period. Downgrades and cancellations take effect at the end of your current billing period. Can I try Tasklet for free?Yes. The Free plan lets you explore Tasklet without any commitment. You can upgrade whenever you are ready. Do you offer refunds?If you are unhappy with Tasklet, we will provide a refund upon request within 14 days of your payment for amounts up to $250. Beyond that, refunds are not available. Please downgrade your account to the Free plan before contacting our team. For more information or custom enterprise pricing, please contact our team . To apply, email our CEO Andrew (andrew@tasklet.ai ) with your resume, relevant links, and a video introduction no more than five minutes long. Your video must include the following: Who you are & why you want to join Tasklet A confirmation that you are able to work full-time, in-person in SF (including any required work authorizations - we are not sponsoring visas at this time) A demo of the most impressive thing you've made recently that’s relevant to the role you’re applying for. Make sure to show what you made, not just tell us. Email Andrew About Tasklet Building the AI work platform for business. Tasklet is building the AI platform companies use to run their business on agents. Our customers describe an outcome in plain English, and Tasklet gets the work done—across SaaS tools, APIs, browsers, files, spreadsheets, and internal systems. Agents can respond immediately or run business processes in the cloud 24×7 on a schedule or in response to events. Every Tasklet agent gets its own cloud computers, filesystem, database, and browser. Tasklet agents are built to do real work at real companies where many people are involved in each function. Teams share agents, knowledge, connections, and conversations, while administrators control access, behavior, and spend. Tasklet users can choose among models and delegate work to faster, cheaper ones—giving companies one flexible platform instead of a growing pile of disconnected AI seats. Mossberg · Est. 1919 Chapter 01 What we care about Why Harmony exists SEE UNIFY ACT What We Care About People are not meant to spend their lives on soul-crushing work. Behind every plant are real people carrying real responsibility and doing the work that keeps everyday life moving. The deeper we got into manufacturing, the more we realized how much it matters, not just to this country, but to the families, communities, and people behind it. We believe the point of automation is simple: give people their time back. Take away the repetitive work that wears them down so they have more time and energy for the work they care about, the people they love, and the life they want to live. We want to help manufacturers move forward without losing what makes them special. And at the end of the day, we want to build something generational. Something that lasts. Something we can look back on one day and be proud we gave our lives to. Something real that helped real people and actually mattered. Chapter 02 Our story A letter from the team WALK STAY LISTEN BUILD Our Story A letter from the Harmony team. Ch. 01The feeling We feel very lucky. Ch. 02The beginning We say that a lot, but we mean it. When we started this company, we were a general automation company trying to figure out where we fit and what we were really meant to build. We always knew we cared deeply about AI automation because, at its core, it can make people's lives better. We have always believed that people are not meant to spend their lives doing repetitive, soul-crushing work. That is not what life is for. Ch. 03The factory visit Then we moved to Chattanooga, Tennessee. Funny enough, we landed in one of the most important manufacturing hubs in the country at exactly the right time in our journey. As we were trying to find our way, we visited a local factory, and that visit changed everything. Ch. 04The opportunity Very quickly, we realized there was a real opportunity here. Not to "disrupt" manufacturing or "revolutionize" it, because those words get thrown around too easily and honestly feel like bullshit. It was something much simpler and much more important than that. We saw an opportunity to help manufacturers move forward, adopt better technology, and make sure they were not left behind. Ch. 05The obsession What started as curiosity turned into genuine obsession. We lived inside that first factory for months and months. We did not just visit. We stayed. We learned. We listened. We watched how things actually worked. Ch. 06The road Since then, our team has spent time in dozens of factories across the United States and in other countries too. We have worked early shifts, late shifts, long days, and weekends. We have driven hours into small towns, crossed borders, and gone wherever we needed to go to be close to the work. Our team genuinely moves to anywhere the factory is located. Ch. 07Falling in love And the deeper we got, the more we fell in love with manufacturing. We feel lucky because we stumbled into something that matters so much. Manufacturing is not just an industry. It is deeply tied to family, legacy, community, and the everyday life of this country. It powers nearly everything around us, even the things most people never stop to think about. Behind all of it are real people doing real work. People keeping plants running, solving problems under pressure, and holding together systems that the rest of the world depends on. There is something very beautiful about that. We are honored to be a small part of it. Ch. 08The reason This company exists to make people's lives better. That is still the simplest and most honest way to describe what we do. We are here to remove the kind of work that wears people down and replaces their time with frustration, busywork, and unnecessary manual effort. We are here to build software that actually helps. Software that feels personal. Software that delivers a real outcome. That is why we do things the way we do them. Ch. 09The method We do not sit far away from the problem and pretend to understand it. We go live in these factories. We embed with the people. We start on the factory floor. We learn from operators, supervisors, planners, and plant leaders. We earn trust by being there and by doing the hard part with them. Our team is spread across the country doing exactly that every day. They are waking up early, staying late, and building close relationships with the people inside these plants every single day, because that is the only way to make software that truly helps. Ch. 10The broken model That is also why we believe so strongly that the old model is broken. Too many manufacturers have been lied to. They have been sold expensive software that promised everything and delivered very little. They have been gouged on price, left with clunky systems, and forced to deal with consultants who charged a fortune without actually solving the problem. We hate that. We think it is bullshit, and we think it is wrong. It should not be like that. Manufacturers deserve honesty, real partnership, and software that actually makes life easier for the people inside the plant. Ch. 11The commitment We start small. We prove value. We stay close to the work. And we only win if the manufacturer wins. That is why we price based on outcomes. We believe software should be tied to real results, especially in an industry this important. Ch. 12The legacy At the end of the day, our mission is bigger than just automation. We want to help protect the legacy of family-owned plants. We want to help large manufacturers move faster and stay competitive. We want to help America build better, operate better, and stay strong for the future. We believe AI can play a real role in that, not in some abstract way, but in a practical, grounded, everyday way that makes work better for the people actually doing it. We want to do the hard work that others avoid. We want to go where the problem is real. We want to build with the people who keep this country running. If we get to spend our lives doing that, we will be very proud of what we built. Every workflow, every integration, every model we ship is tested against these. If it doesn't hold up on the floor, it doesn't ship. Principle 01 Go on-site. Live in the factory. We do not sit far away from the problem. We embed with the people, start on the floor, and earn trust by being there. Every product decision is made next to the person who has to use it. Principle 02 Start small. Prove value first. We do not sell a promise. We begin with the real work, ship something that holds up on the floor, and grow from there. No massive contracts, no long rollouts before anyone sees a result. Principle 03 Only win if the manufacturer wins. We price based on outcomes. Software should be tied to real results, especially in an industry this important. If the plant is not better off because we showed up, we have not done our job. Principle 04 Remove busywork, not people. Our job is to take the repetitive, soul-crushing parts off a plant's back so the people inside it can do real work. Automations remove the friction, not the humans. Principle 05 Build for the legacy. Family-owned plants, American manufacturers, and the people who keep this country running. Chapter 03 How we hire Ability over resume INTRO BUILD MEET OFFER How We Hire Show us you can build and ship. We care more about what you can do than where you came from. Our process is short, honest, and built around real work. We look at what you have shipped, how you think through hard problems, and whether you can operate inside the messiness of a real plant. We are open to non-traditional candidates when they are exceptional, and new grads are welcome for the right roles. Step 01 Intro conversation. A founder-level call. What you have built, what you want to build, and why this work is interesting to you. Real talk, no HR script. Step 02 Technical interview. A working session with an engineer or the founder, depending on the role. We dig into how you think, how you build, and how you handle real problems under real constraints. Step 03 Take-home project. We send you a scoped problem that looks like something you would actually hit in the first 90 days. You have 72 hours from when we send it to ship it back. Honest scope, ship what you would ship on the job. Step 04 In-person visit. You come to Chattanooga. We cover the flight, the accommodation, all of it. We take you to a factory, have you meet one of our clients, and show you how the product actually works in real time. You spend the day with the team, working through the kind of problems you would own. If an in-person visit is not possible, we do a long-form virtual session instead. Step 05 Same-day decision. We give you the answer by the end of the day you visit. If we say yes, we give you the offer letter that same day and start onboarding. If we say no, we tell you why and respect your time. American manufacturing is the backbone of the country. The people running it deserve software that actually helps. That is the work. Reason 02 You ship where it's used. We embed with customers. We watch software get used in the middle of a shift. Every deployment sharpens the next one. You see your work in the real world, not in a staging environment. Reason 03 High ownership, high trust. Everyone owns outcomes, not just tasks. If you see a better way, you have the room to build it. Reason 04 Serious about craft. We build tools we are proud of. Clean models, cited AI, sharp interfaces, real-time data, and software that respects the people using it. No sloppy work makes it out the door. Mossberg · Est. 1919 Chapter 01 What we care about Why Harmony exists SEE UNIFY ACT What We Care About People are not meant to spend their lives on soul-crushing work. Behind every plant are real people carrying real responsibility and doing the work that keeps everyday life moving. The deeper we got into manufacturing, the more we realized how much it matters, not just to this country, but to the families, communities, and people behind it. We believe the point of automation is simple: give people their time back. Take away the repetitive work that wears them down so they have more time and energy for the work they care about, the people they love, and the life they want to live. We want to help manufacturers move forward without losing what makes them special. And at the end of the day, we want to build something generational. Something that lasts. Something we can look back on one day and be proud we gave our lives to. Something real that helped real people and actually mattered. Chapter 02 Our story A letter from the team WALK STAY LISTEN BUILD Our Story A letter from the Harmony team. Ch. 01The feeling We feel very lucky. Ch. 02The beginning We say that a lot, but we mean it. When we started this company, we were a general automation company trying to figure out where we fit and what we were really meant to build. We always knew we cared deeply about AI automation because, at its core, it can make people's lives better. We have always believed that people are not meant to spend their lives doing repetitive, soul-crushing work. That is not what life is for. Ch. 03The factory visit Then we moved to Chattanooga, Tennessee. Funny enough, we landed in one of the most important manufacturing hubs in the country at exactly the right time in our journey. As we were trying to find our way, we visited a local factory, and that visit changed everything. Ch. 04The opportunity Very quickly, we realized there was a real opportunity here. Not to "disrupt" manufacturing or "revolutionize" it, because those words get thrown around too easily and honestly feel like bullshit. It was something much simpler and much more important than that. We saw an opportunity to help manufacturers move forward, adopt better technology, and make sure they were not left behind. Ch. 05The obsession What started as curiosity turned into genuine obsession. We lived inside that first factory for months and months. We did not just visit. We stayed. We learned. We listened. We watched how things actually worked. Ch. 06The road Since then, our team has spent time in dozens of factories across the United States and in other countries too. We have worked early shifts, late shifts, long days, and weekends. We have driven hours into small towns, crossed borders, and gone wherever we needed to go to be close to the work. Our team genuinely moves to anywhere the factory is located. Ch. 07Falling in love And the deeper we got, the more we fell in love with manufacturing. We feel lucky because we stumbled into something that matters so much. Manufacturing is not just an industry. It is deeply tied to family, legacy, community, and the everyday life of this country. It powers nearly everything around us, even the things most people never stop to think about. Behind all of it are real people doing real work. People keeping plants running, solving problems under pressure, and holding together systems that the rest of the world depends on. There is something very beautiful about that. We are honored to be a small part of it. Ch. 08The reason This company exists to make people's lives better. That is still the simplest and most honest way to describe what we do. We are here to remove the kind of work that wears people down and replaces their time with frustration, busywork, and unnecessary manual effort. We are here to build software that actually helps. Software that feels personal. Software that delivers a real outcome. That is why we do things the way we do them. Ch. 09The method We do not sit far away from the problem and pretend to understand it. We go live in these factories. We embed with the people. We start on the factory floor. We learn from operators, supervisors, planners, and plant leaders. We earn trust by being there and by doing the hard part with them. Our team is spread across the country doing exactly that every day. They are waking up early, staying late, and building close relationships with the people inside these plants every single day, because that is the only way to make software that truly helps. Ch. 10The broken model That is also why we believe so strongly that the old model is broken. Too many manufacturers have been lied to. They have been sold expensive software that promised everything and delivered very little. They have been gouged on price, left with clunky systems, and forced to deal with consultants who charged a fortune without actually solving the problem. We hate that. We think it is bullshit, and we think it is wrong. It should not be like that. Manufacturers deserve honesty, real partnership, and software that actually makes life easier for the people inside the plant. Ch. 11The commitment We start small. We prove value. We stay close to the work. And we only win if the manufacturer wins. That is why we price based on outcomes. We believe software should be tied to real results, especially in an industry this important. Ch. 12The legacy At the end of the day, our mission is bigger than just automation. We want to help protect the legacy of family-owned plants. We want to help large manufacturers move faster and stay competitive. We want to help America build better, operate better, and stay strong for the future. We believe AI can play a real role in that, not in some abstract way, but in a practical, grounded, everyday way that makes work better for the people actually doing it. We want to do the hard work that others avoid. We want to go where the problem is real. We want to build with the people who keep this country running. If we get to spend our lives doing that, we will be very proud of what we built. Chapter 03 The approach How we build 01 02 03 04 05 Featured in Times Square, New York · 2026 — See the post → The Approach Five principles we build everything against. Every workflow, every integration, every model we ship is tested against these. If it doesn't hold up on the floor, it doesn't ship. Principle 01 Go on-site. Live in the factory. We do not sit far away from the problem. We embed with the people, start on the floor, and earn trust by being there. Every product decision is made next to the person who has to use it. Principle 02 Start small. Prove value first. We do not sell a promise. We begin with the real work, ship something that holds up on the floor, and grow from there. No massive contracts, no long rollouts before anyone sees a result. Principle 03 Only win if the manufacturer wins. We price based on outcomes. Software should be tied to real results, especially in an industry this important. If the plant is not better off because we showed up, we have not done our job. Principle 04 Remove busywork, not people. Our job is to take the repetitive, soul-crushing parts off a plant's back so the people inside it can do real work. Automations remove the friction, not the humans. Principle 05 Build for the legacy. Family-owned plants, American manufacturers, and the people who keep this country running. Our job is to help them last. We are building something generational, not something quarterly. Chapter 04 The team Chattanooga, Tennessee US TN CHA The Team Close to the work. Close to the plants. We are based in Chattanooga, Tennessee, not Palo Alto, because we want to be where the work is. We live near real manufacturing hubs so we can understand our customers better, serve them faster, and stay close to the floors that shape the product. We are looking for builders who want to work on real operational problems alongside the plants that run them, and ship software that actually holds up on the floor. See Open Roles → Talk to Us Chapter 01 Who we're looking for Builders, not talkers BUILD OWN SHIP Who We're Looking For People who build. People who finish. You do not need a pedigree. You need to be able to think clearly, move fast, and ship work that holds up. We are looking for people who want responsibility, who can work across product, engineering, and operations, and who are excited by real industrial systems, robotics, AI, infrastructure, and the operational complexity of a real plant. If a clean dashboard is the most interesting problem in your life, this is not the place. Trait 01 Builder mindset. You default to making. You do not wait for permission, spec documents, or perfect conditions. You build, ship, learn, and build again. Trait 02 High agency. You take ownership of outcomes, not just tickets. You figure out what matters, decide, and act. Ambiguity does not stop you. Trait 03 Practical judgment. You know the difference between the elegant answer and the right answer. You prefer shipping something real over shipping something perfect. Trait 04 Serious about the work, not yourself. You respect the operator on the floor. You take manufacturing seriously. You also know how to have fun and have a laugh. The mission is heavy; the team shouldn't be. Trait 05 You're locked in. You work hard. You learn fast. You're willing to do whatever the moment needs, without complaining about what's in your job description. And you have fun while doing it. Chapter 02 Open roles 17 Open positions · apply now ENG DESIGN AI ROBO Open Roles Roles we're hiring right now. Seventeen open positions. A small, focused team. We are moving fast and taking roles seriously. If one of these fits, reach out. We respond to every serious applicant. Engineering 7 openings Full-Stack Software Engineer Embed on-site with customers to scope workflows, prototype fast, and ship production-grade software on their infrastructure, Python, TypeScript, React, Postgres, Docker/K8s, Terraform. In parallel, build the reusable tooling (SDKs, templates, adapters, CLIs) that makes the next deployment faster than the last. Full-time In-person only $100K+ Equity TBD 0–1+ years New grads welcome High ownership Location TBD · depends on travel · must be willing to relocate Apply → View role → Engineering 1 opening Principal Product Engineer Own the leverage behind every deployment. Set the architecture of the internal platform, define the ontology that lets one plant's data model transfer to the next, and turn a six-week implementation into a two-week one. A hands-on role: write code every day and work directly with the founders. Full-time In-person only Chattanooga, TN $200K+ High-equity 3-5+ years High ownership Chattanooga, TN · in-person only · inside Brickyard Apply → View role → Engineering 1 opening Senior Product Engineer Take the one-off solutions from every deployment and turn them into components the whole company can reuse. Build the integrations, adapters, and internal tooling our forward-deployed engineers rely on, alongside the Principal Product Engineer on the shared data model. Ship fast and see your work land in a real factory within weeks. Harmony's backbone. This is infrastructure work with real operational stakes. Full-time Deployed or on-site Infrastructure High ownership Deployed role · must live in or relocate to a factory location · location TBD Apply → View role → Design 1 opening Founding Designer Shape the product language, operator interfaces, and editorial voice of Harmony. Design for factory floors, not for analytics dashboards. You will own the visual system, the UI patterns, and the tone that a shift uses every day. Full-time Founding role Product · UI · Brand HQ or remote Factory visits required Factory visits required · one deployment required during the first 6 months Apply → View role → AI 1 opening AI Researcher Push the boundaries of what AI can do on a factory floor. Build agents that reason, cite, and act on real operational data. Focus on automations that hold up under production load, not demos. Full-time Research · Applied AI Hybrid Factory visits required Must spend time on-site with customers · travel as needed Apply → View role → Sales 1 opening Sales Development Representative Drive the top of Harmony's funnel. Cold call, cold email, outbound prospecting, follow-up, and event support. Not behind a dashboard, on the phone, at the event, in the plant. Full-time In-person / deployed Outbound · Events Heavy travel High ownership Heavy travel for customer visits, events, and prospecting Apply → View role → Sales 1 opening Head of Sales & Partnerships Lead Harmony's go-to-market motion. Build pipeline, close strategic customers, develop ecosystem partnerships, and build the sales team. Founder-led, in-person, on the road with customers and partners. Full-time Leadership · Founding Deployed Heavy travel Builds the team Deployed role · heavy travel to customers, events, and partner meetings Apply → View role → Robotics 1 opening Head of Robotics Lead Harmony's robotics work. Bridge software, hardware, and the physical floor to make automation practical, safe, and grounded. Build the team from scratch. Own the roadmap. You will spend real time across multiple customer sites, not one. Full-time Leadership · Founding Deployed Heavy travel Builds the team Deployed role · significant travel to customer sites across the country Apply → View role → Deployed roles Several of these roles are deployed. That means you live in or relocate to a factory location, work on-site with the team operating the plant, and ship software inside the environment it runs in. The exact location is TBD and depends on the customer we deploy with. This is how we work. It is how Harmony gets better every release. Benefits What you get. 01 In-person only. Full-time, with frequent travel to customer sites. 02 Accommodation support if relocation is required for a deployment. 03 High-equity compensation. 04 Work directly with the founders every day with full ownership. 05 High-trust, high-intensity environment built on craft, speed, and impact. Chapter 03 How we hire Ability over resume INTRO BUILD MEET OFFER How We Hire Show us you can build and ship. We care more about what you can do than where you came from. Our process is short, honest, and built around real work. We look at what you have shipped, how you think through hard problems, and whether you can operate inside the messiness of a real plant. We are open to non-traditional candidates when they are exceptional, and new grads are welcome for the right roles. Step 01 Intro conversation. A founder-level call. What you have built, what you want to build, and why this work is interesting to you. Real talk, no HR script. Step 02 Technical interview. A working session with an engineer or the founder, depending on the role. We dig into how you think, how you build, and how you handle real problems under real constraints. Step 03 Take-home project. We send you a scoped problem that looks like something you would actually hit in the first 90 days. You have 72 hours from when we send it to ship it back. Honest scope, ship what you would ship on the job. Step 04 In-person visit. You come to Chattanooga. We cover the flight, the accommodation, all of it. We take you to a factory, have you meet one of our clients, and show you how the product actually works in real time. You spend the day with the team, working through the kind of problems you would own. If an in-person visit is not possible, we do a long-form virtual session instead. Step 05 Same-day decision. We give you the answer by the end of the day you visit. If we say yes, we give you the offer letter that same day and start onboarding. If we say no, we tell you why and respect your time. Chapter 04 Why Harmony Real work, real floors MISSION FLOOR OWN SHIP Why Harmony The work is real. So is the impact. Harmony is the operating layer for American manufacturing. We build it alongside the plants that run it, not from a distance. Every feature we ship is used on a real floor by real operators, supervisors, and plant managers. Software that does not hold up in that environment does not make it to production. This keeps the work honest, the feedback loop tight, and the stakes obvious. Reason 01 The problem matters. American manufacturing is the backbone of the country. The people running it deserve software that actually helps. That is the work. Reason 02 You ship where it's used. We embed with customers. We watch software get used in the middle of a shift. Every deployment sharpens the next one. You see your work in the real world, not in a staging environment. Reason 03 High ownership, high trust. Everyone owns outcomes, not just tasks. If you see a better way, you have the room to build it. Reason 04 Serious about craft. We build tools we are proud of. Clean models, cited AI, sharp interfaces, real-time data, and software that respects the people using it. No sloppy work makes it out the door.
